reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight now step calendar days with setDate and skip days that minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends or disableDayFn close; at a range end they stop on the boundary day, so the maxDate hang of the earlier patch cannot happen.
caveats: ArrowUp and ArrowDown still use the original weekly jump and can land on a closed day.
At a boundary it clamps to minDate or maxDate even when that day is itself disabled.
If disableDayFn closed every day with no minDate or maxDate, the loop would not end; no realistic page does that.
